authors.name: TechnoWorld360 Editorial Team
authors.bio: The TechnoWorld360 editorial team covers phones, laptops, gaming and electric vehicles. We explain what is new, what it costs and whether it is worth your money, in plain English.
authors.about:
We follow the launches, price changes and software updates that affect what people buy and use every day, from new iPhones, Pixels and Galaxy phones to MacBooks, Windows laptops, consoles and EVs.

Each article starts from the primary source, such as the company announcement, the official spec sheet, the regulator filing or the price on the retailer page. We then check it against hands-on testing and reporting from established outlets, and name every source on the page so you can read it yourself. When we have not tested something ourselves, we say so instead of guessing.

Prices and release dates change quickly. Every article shows when it was published and when it was last updated, and we revise our most-read guides when the facts change.

Some articles are drafted with AI assistance. When they are, the page says so, and an editor checks the facts, figures and sources before it goes live.

Spotted a mistake or have a tip? Contact us through the contact page. We correct errors on the page and add a dated note explaining what changed.
